description: This file defines the LocationEntry class, which models a GPS location point with associated timestamp and derived day information. It includes fields for latitude, longitude, a Calendar object representing the time, and a string for the day. The class provides a constructor to initialize these fields, and overrides equals() and hashCode() methods for object comparison based on the timestamp.

classes.name: LocationEntry
classes.description: Models a GPS location with timestamp and day information, including equality and hash code implementations.

methods.name: LocationEntry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the location entry with a calendar timestamp, latitude, longitude, and computes the hashed day.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare LocationEntry objects based on calendar timestamp.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to use the calendar's hash code.
